items.t: Worn ignition switch can cause no-start or stalling (recall)
items.note: Usually free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Honda dealer.

items.t: Automatic transmission slipping and failure
items.job: Replace transmission with a remanufactured unit
items.note: A used unit costs less. The high end is a new dealer transmission.

items.t: Takata 'Alpha' airbag inflator: do-not-drive warning
items.job: Replace driver and passenger airbag inflators (recall remedy)
items.note: Free under recall 19V-182. Do not drive it; Honda can tow it or send a mobile tech.

items.t: Radio and climate-control display goes dim or dark
items.job: Repair or replace audio and climate display unit
items.note: A board-level repair by a specialist often costs less than a new unit.

items.t: Loud rattle for a few seconds on cold start (VTC actuator)
items.note: Fixing it early helps avoid timing chain wear.

items.t: Rear brake pads wear out early
items.note: Rotors may need replacing too if pads wore to metal.

items.t: Rusted front driveshaft can break (recall)
items.note: Usually free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Honda dealer.

items.t: CVT belt slip with engine-speed surge (software update)
items.note: If the CVT is already damaged, replacing it costs much more.

items.t: Passenger seat weight sensor can crack (airbag recall)
items.note: Usually free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Honda dealer.

items.t: In-tank fuel pump can fail (recall)
items.note: Usually free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Honda dealer.

items.t: Stability-control unit can leak brake fluid (recall)
items.note: Usually free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Honda dealer.

items.t: High-pressure fuel pump can crack and leak (recall)
items.note: Usually free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Honda dealer.

items.t: Front seat belt pretensioner may be missing a rivet (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace front seat belt pretensioners as needed (recall remedy)
items.note: Free under recall 23V-782. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Power steering hose can leak onto hot exhaust (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 12V-222. Check the VIN first.

items.t: 12-volt battery sensor can short and start a fire (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 17V-418. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Starter motor wears out early or grinds
items.note: Test the battery first. V6 automatics may also need the torque converter repositioned.

items.t: LED daytime running lights burn out
items.note: Ask the dealer about warranty extension bulletin 19-042 before paying.

items.t: Automatic transmission bearing can break (recall)
items.job: Update automatic transmission control software (recall remedy)
items.note: Free under recall 11V-395. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Driver airbag inflator can rupture or underinflate (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace driver airbag inflator (recall remedy)
items.note: Free under recall 20V-026. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Parking pawl may not hold the car in Park (recall)
items.job: Install a collar on the transmission parking pawl lever (recall remedy)
items.note: Free under recall 98V-018. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Hybrid system can reset and cut drive power (recall)
items.job: Update hybrid control module software (recall remedy)
items.note: Free under recall 25V-785. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Tire repair kit sealant bottle cap can come off (recall)
items.job: Replace tire repair kit nozzle or sealant bottle (recall remedy)
items.note: Free under recall 26V-366 or 26V-663. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Driver seat cushion frame may be loose (recall)
items.job: Replace driver seat cushion frame (recall remedy)
items.note: Free under recall 24V-859 or 26V-054. Check the VIN first.
